Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: openserv-agent-sdk
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides an SDK and examples for building AI agents on the OpenServ platform. It demonstrates powerful capabilities such as accessing workspace secrets, performing file operations (upload/delete), and calling external integrations. While these capabilities are inherently high-risk if misused, the provided code and documentation consistently show them being used for legitimate purposes within the platform's context. For instance, `examples/secrets.ts` explicitly warns against logging secret values, and network connections (`agents-proxy.openserv.ai`) are clearly stated as part of the local development tunneling feature. There is no evidence of intentional harmful behavior, prompt injection against the agent, or obfuscation to hide malicious actions across any of the files.
